scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs packages/toolbar examples/vanilla-consumer examples/react-consumer
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs packages/toolbar examples/vanilla-consumer examples/react-consumer
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @moorkyz/toolbar typecheck && pnpm --filter vanilla-consumer typecheck && pnpm --filter react-consumer typecheck
